name: Executive Order 14110 on Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy AI

use_case_categories: Federal agency AI use, dual-use foundation models, critical infrastructure AI
scope.description: Applies to federal agencies and companies developing dual-use foundation models above compute thresholds.

requirements.obligation: Developers of dual-use foundation models must notify the federal government and share safety test results
Establish standards for red-team testing of AI systems
Federal agencies must designate Chief AI Officers
Agencies must complete AI use case inventories per OMB M-24-10
Establish AI safety standards and best practices through NIST

ai_risk_tier: Maps to GAIF Critical for dual-use foundation models, High for federal agency AI

compliance_routing_rules: Federal AI systems must route through FedRAMP-authorized endpoints
behavioral_contract_thresholds: Safety test results must be shared before deployment
disclosure_requirements: AI use case inventory per OMB M-24-10
Content authentication and watermarking for AI-generated content
monitoring_requirements: Ongoing monitoring of AI system impacts
